d: Russia has upgraded its Mi-28NM attack helicopters to launch long-range cruise missiles. Footage released by the Russian Ministry of Defence shows a Mi-28NM firing two Dan-T long-range cruise missiles at Ukrainian posts. As per reports, the helicopter can also fire S8000 Banderol missiles. The Mi-28 is an attack helicopter that can carry out daytime and nighttime operations and can even conduct missions in bad weather conditions.
